sources.title: Realistic Vision V6.0 B1 - V5.1 (VAE) - SD 1.5 | Diffus
sources.snippet: Realistic Vision V6.0 is a fully retrained Stable Diffusion model offering improved photorealistic image generation with 724k training steps on 3400+ images. It supports samplers like DPM SDE++ Karras and Euler A with optimized parameters for quality results. Recommended usage includes CFG scales 1.5-7, clip skip 1-2, and hires fix via 4x-UltraSharp upscaler with denoising strength 0.25-0.45 ...
